description: This file defines Express.js routes for project-related API endpoints, including project name resolution and cost/usage calculations, utilizing external services and utilities.

methods.name: round6
methods.description: Rounds a number to 6 decimal places to match normalization standards.

methods.name: computeProjectCostUSD
methods.description: Asynchronously computes total USD cost for a given projectId using analytics.getCosts.

methods.name: buildUsagePayload
methods.description: Builds a payload object with project cost and credits information, including both camelCase and snake_case fields.
